title: Crepitation
summary: CREPITATION, noun 1. The act of bursting with a frequent repetition of sharp sounds; the noise of some salts in calcination; crackling. 2. The noise of fractured bones, when moved by a surgeon to asce

inlines.v: CREPITATION, noun 1. The act of bursting with a frequent repetition of sharp sounds; the noise of some salts in calcination; crackling. 2. The noise of fractured bones, when moved by a surgeon to ascertain a fracture.
